newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish domestic debt jumps 131.4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkish domestic debt jumps 131.4 pct in 1996.

text.p: Turkey's outstanding domestic debt stood at 3,149 trillion lira at the end of 1996, up 131.4 percent from 1,361 trillion lira at end-1995, the Treasury said in a statement on Thursday.
T-bills with less than one-year maturity made up 1,528 trillion lira of the total domestic debt stock and bonds having one-year or longer maturity made up 1,250 trillion of it.
The end-1995 figures were 631.3 trillion lira of t-bills and 511.8 trillion lira of bonds.
Central bank's cash advances to the Treasury stood at 371 trillion lira at end-1996, up from 192 trillion a year ago.
